Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 31, 2026

1. Information We Collect

We collect minimal information to operate this website:

  • Usage data: Pages visited, time on site, approximate location (country/state level) via Google Analytics.
  • Cookies: Small text files stored on your device to remember preferences and serve relevant advertising.
  • Voluntary submissions: If you contact us via email, we retain your email address and message content.

2. How We Use Information

We use collected data to:

  • Understand which guides are most helpful and improve content quality.
  • Display relevant advertising through Google AdSense.
  • Respond to user inquiries and feedback.

3. Third-Party Services

We use the following third-party services that may collect data:

  • Google Analytics: For traffic analysis. See Google's Privacy Policy.
  • Google AdSense: For advertising. See Google's Ads Policy.
  • Hosting (Vercel): For serving the website. See Vercel's Privacy Policy.

4. Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights to:

  • Request access to your personal data.
  • Request deletion of your personal data.
  • Opt out of personalized advertising via Google Ad Settings.

5. Contact

Privacy-related questions: thor19daniel@gmail.com
